firstPlayerRule: Players first choose who controls the Rebels and who controls the Imperials (randomly if they cannot decide). The Rebel player goes first: they assign leaders to missions first and take the first turn of each Command Phase.
clarifications: In the Assignment Phase, the Rebel player assigns leaders first, then the Imperial player.
In the Command Phase, starting with the Rebel player, players alternate turns activating a system or revealing a mission.
The Rebel player also deploys units first during the Refresh Phase.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the Fantasy Flight Games Learn to Play (SHA-256 b26b98139d694e9f42cb36060ec82fdc3000ab753d29809be03b7bc44d8598fc, 20 pages) and Rules Reference (SHA-256 0b5af3a28bc4bc29a16f84456ed3a6543bf4d6a141461971e6fb170c6afba35a, 16 pages); both links were taken from an archived copy of the FFG Star Wars: Rebellion product page. Learn to Play page 4: players choose Imperial/Rebel sides, randomly if they cannot decide; page 6: the Rebel player starts by assigning leaders, then the Imperial player; page 7: starting with the Rebel player, players alternate Command Phase turns. Rules Reference page 6 confirms the Rebel player takes the first Command Phase turn. Game identity confirmed by title, faction content and FFG product page (BGG 187645). Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
